items.information: This competition is on a **Tuesday Evening** and will only feature the 3x3 Fewest Movesand Blindfolded events. As a result, this competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider [OH in a Madison Ballroom](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OHinaMadisonBallroom2023) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
